safety_invariants: Strict offline-only fake driver: no Windows mouse/keyboard imports or physical input APIs
SQLite dispatch-uncertain boundary committed before fake-only attempt
Focus, account, window generation, character identity and calibration re-attested with two observations
Missing second attestation remains uncertain, not silently treated as valid
Cross-account busy gate cancels only the second PREPARED action without clearing previous uncertainty
Fake driver receipt cannot prove outcome; only independently supplied exact-scoped synthetic evidence may settle
Crashes and exceptions never cause blind retries or success classification
Incident ZIP includes first observed boundary, explicit failure reason, action status and checksum verification
limitations: Windows live window identity/focus and hardware calibration unverified
No real mouse, keyboard or game input enabled
Simulated outcome settlement is not server confirmation
Potential physical dispatch after sudden power loss not tested
Historic intermittent verification delays and SQLite ResourceWarnings remain open
note: Progress is an approximate weighted roadmap estimate, not a reliability or quality measurement.
